metadata.title: Predicting the Mathematics Literacy of Resilient Students from High‐performing Economies: A Machine Learning Approach

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study explicitly states that it applied Rubin's rules for handling plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly mentions that student weights were used in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide information indicating that multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors were used, suggesting that school clustering was ignored.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and appears to rely solely on internal validation techniques.
design_fields._pdf_matched: 31. Zhang & Cutumisu. (2024). Predicting the Mathematics Literacy of Resilient Student.pdf
design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): applied two machine learning algorithms, Lasso Regression (LR) and Random Forest (RF), to predict the mathematics literacy of resilient students from high-performing economies across cultures in PISA 2022. The findings indicated both RF and LR performed better in Western cultures than in Eastern cultures.
